data.title: Atlético reach state championship semi-finals at U13 and U14 levels - Yahoo Sports
data.content: Atlético secured their place in the semifinals of the Under-13 and Under-14 Minas Gerais State Championships. Galo's youngsters beat Inter de Minas in matches played on Sunday morning (18) to seal qualification. The Under-13s won 4–0, with goals from forwards Abner, Luis Miguel, Caio Souza and João Pedro. The Under-14s won 3–0, with goals from midfielders Anglerson Tonico and Barroso and forward Ryan Ayslan. In the first legs, the Under-13s won 2–0, with goals from midfielder Gustavo Henrique and forward Walace Araújo. The Under-14s cruised to a 4–0 win, with goals from midfielder Foguete and forwards Eric Sebastião, Ryan Ayslan and Miguel Bueno. With both quarterfinal wins, the Under-13s maintained their perfect record in the championship. The Under-14s have 13 wins, one draw and three defeats in the competition, with 50 goals scored and 10 conceded. Both teams await the result of the match between Athletic and Boston, scheduled for next Saturday (24), to find out who they will face in the semifinals.
